name: Marquee row
look: One row of client words, trades, cities or formats moves slowly sideways in a loop, fading at both edges; it pauses under the pointer and has a pause button.
reduced: The words stand in a wrapped row.
phone: The words stand in a wrapped row; nothing runs.

needs.words: 6 to 14 real words (trades, cities, formats), never logos and never invented clients
